paths.title: Betaflight
paths.goal: Build, set up and tune a Betaflight quadcopter deliberately: ports, modes, failsafe, filters, data-driven PID, automation.

paths.title: INAV
paths.goal: Move from manual flight to position hold, return to home and missions; set up a wing.

paths.title: ArduPilot
paths.goal: Build and verify autonomous scenarios: first in a simulator, then on an octo and a VTOL, with log analysis.

paths.title: PX4
paths.goal: Understand how PX4 is built and connect it with ROS 2 and a companion computer.

groups.title: Foundations
